text: Hypodense cortico-subcortical sequelae in the left temporal pole and left temporal lobe, without spontaneous hyperdensity.
Passive traction of the left temporal horn of the lateral ventricle.
Ventricular system normal in size and morphology.
No spontaneous density abnormality in the brainstem or cerebellum.
Midline fourth ventricle normal in size and morphology.
Normal appearance of the basal cisterns.
